breaking: Two new database files, 005_model_steps.sql (token counts for each model call, kept on the server) and 006_approval_session.sql (which conversation an approval card belongs to, so a revised draft can withdraw the older card). The update applies them and they are safe to run twice; a rollback does not undo them, so to go back past them restore the backup the update took.

A server installed from a copy of the repository switches once to get-lares.sh and the lares command, as described in docs/releases/rc.12-notes.md. The switch does not take a backup of its own and cannot be undone with lares rollback; take and check a backup first.
Typing approve in chat no longer approves a tool card; only the button or the console does.
